notes.title: The Dissection Deepens – Info on the Next Wound Man Update

More news soon![/p][p][/p][p]Jeff @ Aspidochelone Studios[/p]

notes.title: Wound Man 0.6.0 Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711059/83772543c005b1a4c0149e2e3d7369ff4dddc29f.png[/img][h1]Wound Man's Aquarium of Anatomical Artifacts[/h1]

The latest Wound Man update is packed with mystery, challenge, and just the right amount of gruesome allure.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711059/2fcd785fdc6db0a7f0e69f6a207b62b91c94ab00.png[/img]
[h2]What's New?[/h2]
[h3]New Bonus Levels (12)[/h3]
These aren’t just more of the same — each one is a strange, standalone slice of macabre madness.
How to unlock them? Seek out 10 hidden artifacts tucked away in the main game!

[h3]The Aquarium[/h3]
Once you collect an artifact, it’s displayed in a spooky underwater shrine - Wound Man's Aquarium of Anatomical Artifacts.
Think of it as your personal museum of secrets — and from here, you can access any unlocked bonus level at your leisure.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711059/20a0ce272abd0d590cfe122a9696b11ff0738b4f.png[/img]
[h3]New Critters (10)[/h3]
The Cabinet of Curiosities is getting crowded!
Keep exploring and uncovering to find these fresh oddities.

[h3]New Mini-games and Mini-puzzles (3)[/h3]
Bite-sized but deadly — test your wits and resolve in two new diversions.

[h3]New Steam Achievements (5)[/h3]
For the hunters, the completists, and the truly obsessed.

This update rewards exploration and curiosity — so poke around, listen closely, and leave no crack unexamined. If you’ve already finished the game, now’s the perfect time to dive back in.

As always, thank you for playing Wound Man. Your support, reviews, and feedback keep the world strange and alive.

Stay wounded,

Jeff @ Aspidochelone Studios

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711059/43c13ccc10cc8335682a69f511915d04b5cce3ec.png[/img]

notes.title: Update 0.5.2 - Wound Man's Bookmark!
notes.notes:
[h2][b]Update 0.5.2 introduces the Bookmark![/b] [/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711059/4776b500a1a22f5f24e23664b9ab93811acbbdc3.png[/img]
The bookmark is accessible in all levels and gives you a quick visual overview of your progress. 
With the bookmark you can see the following:
[list]
[*] Current level number
[*] Current level completion status
[*] Secret found
[*] Manuscript found
[*] Curiosity reward
[*] Extra items
[/list]


[b][h2]Clicking the icons on the bookmark opens additional panels.[/h2][/b]
Click on the level icon to reveal the Level Status Panel.  Here you can see your progress for the three difficulty levels. You can click on the level icons in the panel to jump to that level.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711059/6eaa3da787dc5fbf9b51cace2f9183b178ff1f65.png[/img]

This panel is now also available on the Level Select screen.  Click the eye icon to open the panel.  When all of the items in a level (Casual, Challenge and Special) are found, the eye icon will be colored in.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711059/7f1389665fa8dc4f3b55d005fb138ee63fddadf2.png[/img]

Click on the Secret to see details as well as Wound Mans description of the item. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711059/8480b914db7a1a7130bfa2b9e5a6fc946c1610ff.png[/img]

Click on the Manuscript to see an enlarged image.  (See note on Manuscripts down below).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711059/73d8015f3f556af4aa6d913cf0688e5642c8a6bc.png[/img]

Click on the Curiosity to see an enlarged image.  You can name your curiosities too!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711059/54a38cd8ab740f6ebf51bc53d3e56362684617cb.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711059/6d19860e24eb83007c09f988ba4b7c0ea22bdcef.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711059/b5db863583fbbf02395b198d021411a96b11ed76.png[/img]

Click on the Extras icon (if available) to see the extra items to be found in the level.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711059/090e812544d0432ca731174a933443c06ec9c8ed.png[/img]



[h2]Manuscripts - COMING SOON[/h2]
Manuscript content is currently [b]not available[/b].  The functionality will be implemented in a future update.  As a result, 100% completion of the game is not possible at this time.  I am working hard to complete this feature.  Just FYI, finding the level manuscript will unlock information about the images. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711059/e7f61ac9fe719f3b2a52613a10925256e7dfcfff.png[/img]

As always, thank you very much for playing Wound Man.  Your feedback is very valuable, so please feel free to leave comments and ask questions.  If you can please leave a review for the game.

See you next time,  

Jeff @ Aspidochelone Studios

notes.title: Wound Man Update 0.4.3
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711059/54ba06d588ae15675584cc39ed6c6965f6e09c6a.png[/img]

[h2]Thank you for playing Wound Man![/h2]

[h3]Update 0.4.3 is available for download now.[/h3]

This update includes a new cinematic intro, reworked levels for 105 (Eye) and 126 (Dinosaur Skeleton).
There are also various bug fixes and optimizations. 

[h2]Level 105 (Eye)[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711059/b648a718bfb3661cc6a6c23022d3b4d1aa6b4384.png[/img]
The original eye level received feedback for not being intuitive, so it has been replaced with a new eye level that I hope will be more enjoyable to play. The original version will be moved to a different section of the game, which is currently under development

[h2]Level 126 (Dinosaur --> Sea Dragon)[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711059/7880d3a50ec6c9782adb71de8dda5bd8e16efbd1.png[/img]
I originally planned to include more dinosaur content in the game, but that idea was put on the back burner. As a result, there was only one dinosaur level, which felt out of place compared to the rest of the content. So, I replaced it with another sea dragon level, which I believe fits better thematically. Like the eye level, the dinosaur will be moved to a different section of the game, which is currently under development.

[h2]Cinematic Intro[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711059/4a42719f319a29e9ca53198874ad711271a560ea.png[/img]
This version introduces a new cinematic intro that briefly lays out Wound Man's origin story. It took a bit longer to create than I initially expected. I had originally hoped to make it interactive, but to release the game in a reasonable timeframe, I had to set that plan aside. However, creating this cinematic helped me develop the skills needed to incorporate more story elements into the game, which will eventually lead to an overarching storyline and multiple endings. Look for these in future updates.

Here are a few more stills from the intro.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711059/5e12ee89ce7e0bde115b7040132cc9efee1965d1.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711059/65b93a25cc4f374afdd79897d4d62bf8f11c076b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711059/dfc6308f04ce9325965de2ad3e2710b43aa67a5b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711059/175be6ce2ed3ae123aad2e0998a4421d33ec52fd.png[/img]

I want to thank everyone who has played and supported the game! Your feedback has been incredibly helpful in improving and refining the experience. I’m truly grateful for all the input, and I’m excited to keep making the game better with your help. If you’re enjoying the game, please consider sharing it with friends and the community—your support means the world to me!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711059/a14fec6bb3c18e0ba9ee5e174986fb8bc67c67b1.png[/img]

notes.title: Next Wound Man Update Coming Soon!
notes.notes:
Big thanks to everyone for giving Wound Man a chance.  Thank you for playing and spreading the word.
I have been quiet for the past few months, but I have been hard at work on some special additions to the game.  Here are the main points:

[h2]New Opening Cinematic[/h2]
In the next update, you will be able to see the origin story of Wound Man told though the opening cinematic.  Working on this introduction has given me the skill and confidence to add more cinematics to the game which will help progress the main story line and reward intrepid players with multiple endings.

You will also notice that two of the levels have changed.  The Eye level has a brand new look and the Dinosaur Skeleton level has been replaced with a second Sea Dragon level.  The main purpose of this switch was to maintain thematic consistency across levels.  As mentioned in an early announcement, these old levels will NOT be removed from the game.  They will be moved to a new section of the game.  That new section is still under development, so the old Eye Level and Dinosaur Level will be temporarily unavailable.

[h2]Wound Man's Lacerated Legacy Expansion[/h2]
The Lacerated Legacy expansion is next up on the to do list.  Once I have completed the current update, I will get down to work on finishing this expansion.  At the moment it is about 25% complete.

[h2]Feedback[/h2]
As always, I love getting your feedback.  Please let me know what you think about the game - good points, bad points, requests - all are welcome.  And finally, thank you for spreading the word about Wound Man!  It is a strange little game and I hope it finds its way into the hands of all the people who might like it.

notes.title: June 2024 News Update
notes.notes:
[h2]Thanks to everyone for playing the game.  Your feedback is very appreciated![/h2]

Here are a few things that I've been working on since the last update. 


[h2]Level Tweaks[/h2]
Two levels will be changed in a future update.
The eye level will be replaced with a different eye level.  Here is the new artwork.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711059/8f4d1bd06b3fe46cb553c59eb3c4ce62d59a3de6.png[/img]

The dinosaur level will be replaced with another sea monster level.  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711059/28a706a107ef082ef4ace99794033c6c5aa37a53.png[/img]

The original eye level and dinosaur level will not be removed from the game, they will just be moved to a different section of the game. That section is currently under development.  


[h2]Story Expansion[/h2]

notes.title: Wound Man Content Update - Coming Soon
notes.notes:
We've had a lot of new players recently, so I wanted to give a little update on what I've been working on and what to expect in future updates. 

First of all, thank you for playing!  Please feel free to send feedback and suggestions.  
Your feedback helps guide the development!

Wound Man update 0.4.0 will be ready in a few weeks.  This update will include a large content update.  The content currently stands on it's own, but will eventually be blended into story elements, which are planned for the future.  
This update will add "secrets".  These secrets range from hidden objects to mini games and multi-step puzzles.  This update will add the first 30 "secrets" to the game.  It will also open the Secret Collection - a place to store all of the secret items you find.  The long term plan is to add a total of 90 secrets - one for each level.     

These updates will be completed in four main stages.  The first stage is almost complete.  I am putting the finishing touches on the secrets and doing the necessary testing and bug fixes.  

In the first update, you can search for parts of Wound Man's body.  Reassembling his body will restore his physical from, giving him the power essential to complete his quest.

notes.title: Wound Man is Available Now!
notes.notes:
[h3]Wound Man ver. 0.1.1 is Now Available![/h3]

After about a year of development, we are thrilled to announce the release of Wound Man in Early Access. We look forward to hearing about your experiences with the game and welcome any feedback you may have.

Wound Man began as a single-concept puzzle and has evolved into a complete game with 90 levels, with more on the way. We have a variety of features in development, which we plan to introduce continuously over the coming months.

[h3]Look out for these updates:[/h3]

   [list]
[*]  Level reward system
[*]     Opening cinematic
[*]     Complete story with multiple endings
[*]     Steam achievements
[*]     Secrets hidden in levels
[*]     User artwork creator
[*]     Detailed information section
[*]     More levels
[*]     More music
[*]     More animations
[*]     ... and much more!
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711059/cc2519c43d61174471219035ad25884ad0cf34f7.gif[/img]
[h3]Who is Wound Man?[/h3]

For those unfamiliar with Wound Man, here's a brief overview. Wound Man first appeared in the 14th and 15th centuries as a medical diagram designed to assist medics and surgeons in identifying various ailments. The image of Wound Man has been modified over the centuries, with various artists adding their own details and flair. Many variations of Wound Man appear in this game.

[h3]What is the Story?[/h3]

In the game, Wound Man serves as your humble guide on a grotesque and macabre adventure. He is a tulpa brought into existence through humanity’s desire to recreate human anatomy on the page. Persisting for centuries as the embodiment of medical drawings crafted throughout the ages, Wound Man was initially formed by master anatomists to provide vital information to medics, healers, and surgeons. He has become the soul of all nameless medical diagrams of the male form.

His tale is one of woe - poked, shot, stabbed, dissected. He has provided an indispensable service, but at what cost? There was a time when he could set aside the horror of his circumstance and find comfort in his plight because of his partner's love. She was a salve to his open wounds. Alas, his partner, once a tulpa herself, has slipped from existence due to the creeping obscurity of her artwork.

Wound Man needs your help. You can revive his lost eternal partner with your thoughts. He is counting on your help to collect pieces of her soul and restore her to her former state.

[h3]What's Next?[/h3]

Currently, Wound Man is unfinished, but we fully intend to deliver a completed game. We appreciate any and all help you can provide through purchasing the game and providing feedback. We hope to offer continuous updates and improvements during the Early Access phase. We will do our best to respond as quickly as possible - we are a small but eager team, so please bear with us.

[h3]Thank You![/h3]

We thank you, and Wound Man thanks you!
